Currency management of RBI
*221. SHRIMATI SARLA MAHESH-
WARI: Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the growing menace of free flow of
counterfeit currency notes from across the
borders, particularly Indo-Nepal Border;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that this has been
the result of bad currency management of
RBI; and
(d) if so, the steps taken by Govern-
ment to improve the currency management
of RBI?
Social sector expenditure
*222. SHRI C.O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of GDP expenditure
on social sector during 1981—1991 and
1991—2001, separately;
(b) the comparative figures of the same
with the East Asian countries during the
above period;
(c) whether it is a fact that our public
spending on social sector has declined;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor;
(e) whether it is also a fact that our social
sector expenditure is much low as compared
to the ratio recommended by the United
Nation's Development Programme; and
(f) if so, what is Government's response
thereto?
Mismanagement in IGNCA
*223. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of TOURISM
AND CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-report captioned
'Indira Centre Specialises in the art of mis-
management', which appeared in the Deccan
Chronicle dated the 1st December, 2001;
(b) if so, whether Government have
carried out any inquiry into the state of
affairs of the Indira Gandhi National Centre
for Arts (IGNCA);
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps proposed to be taken to
address various problems of mismanage-
ment in the IGNCA as highlighted in the
news-report?

Decline in underground water level in
Delhi
*224. SHRIMAT I AMBIKA SONI:
SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the level of underground water is going
down rapidly in the NCT of Delhi;
(b) if so, what steps are being taken to
meet the effects of such decline;
(c) what are the other sources for making
water available to the people; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
popularise rain water harvesting?
Import duty on rubber
*225. SHRI S. RAMACHANDRAN
PILLAI: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the import duty on rubber during the
last three years, year-wise;
(b) whether any State Government has
sought increase in the import duty on rubber;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the action taken by Government
thereon?
Reconstruction Fund for sea food
exporters
*226. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN:
SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Andhra
Pradesh Government has requested the
Central Government to guarantee bonds
worth Rs. 700 crore raised from the market
to help to create a Reconstruction Fund to
bail out sea food exporters in Andhra
Pradesh;
(b) if so, what is Government's reaction
thereto;
(c) whether there is any other such
proposal from any other State; and
(d) if so, what is Government's response
thereto?
Promotion of exports
*227. SHRI LAJPAT RAI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the steps taken or
proposed to be taken for encouraging export
promotion in the country;
(b) whether it is a fact that minimum five
members should be allowed to go to foreign
countries for export promotion development
under Ministry's Market Development
Authority;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether this would boost the export
promotion activities; and
(e) if not, whether Government will
review this decision?
Working of National Library,
Kolkata
*228. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the news-item captioned "Make India a
nation that reads", which appeared in
Hindustan Times of 8th January, 2002;
(b) whether Government have since
decided to appoint a Committee to examine
the working of the National Library, Kolkata
and to make the library movement
successful all over the country;

Flights to foreign countries from
Kolkata
1629. DR. Y. LAKSHMI PRASAD:
SHRI K.M. SAIFULLAH:
SHRIMATI JAYAPRADA
NAHATA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
introduce more international flights
particularly for Hongkong, Singapore and
Jordan from Kolkata International Airport
in view of foolproof security;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, whether Government have
any plan to start more Air India flights
from Kolkata?
Security lapse at Coimbatore airport
1630. SHRI C.P. THIRUNA-
VUKKARASU: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether security lapse has been
reported at the Coimbatore airport as
nearly 25 approach light fittings on the
runway were found missing recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the amount lost in the theft; and
(d) the steps taken by the authority to
avoid such happenings?
Civil Aviation Training Academy in
Bangalore
1631. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under
Government's consideration to set up a
Civil Aviation Training Academy in
Southern part of the country;
(b) whether Karnataka Government
has offered 50 acre of land for setting up
the Academy in Bangalore; and
(c) if so, the details in this regard?
New airports in private sector
1632. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have cleared
any proposal for setting up of any new
airport projects in private sector in the
country;
(b) if so, the location-wise details
thereof;
(c) the details of proposals received
by Government from private sector so far;
and
(d) by when these projects are likely
to be cleared and completed?

Signing of bilaterals by AI
1633. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Air India has signed a
record number of bilaterals with the
airlines operating in the Gulf Countries
in the recent past;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Air India has sought
security clearance for the same?
Discount scheme of IA and Alliance
Air
1634. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines and
Alliance Air have offered heavy discounts
and schemes inspite of the fact that the
Airlines is running into heavy losses;
(b) if so, in what manner airlines plans
to manage losses created by offering
unwanted discounts; and
(c) the details of discounts and
schemes offered by Indian Airlines during
the last one year and how much is the loss
to Indian Airlines on this during the last
one year?
Losses suffered by IA due to aviation
fuel
1635. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
Airlines are incurring losses worth crores
of Rupees on aviation fuel due to
connivance between some officials of air
traffic control and private airliners;
(b) whether Government have received
any such complaint; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
action taken by Government thereon?
Free tickets issued under Desh-Videsh
Scheme
1636. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention
has been drawn to the news-item
captioned "IA scheme flops, Government
pays twice over" which appeared in the
Statesman, New Delhi on 12th February,
2002;
(b) if so, the total number of free
tickets issued to passengers under 'Desh
Videsh' scheme with the total value of
these tickets;
(c) whether Indian Airlines is incurring
heavy losses during the last one year; and
(d) if so, what are the reasons for
announcing various schemes offering
freebies to passengers?
Losses suffered by airports in Andhra
Pradesh
1637. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that most of the
airports in Andhra Pradesh are incurring
losses;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years, year-wise and airport-
wise;
(c) the reasons for incurring consistent
losses by these airports; and
(d) the remedial measures being taken
to improve the situation?
